text: A phishing email dated 26 Oct impersonated Northmoor Bank from a look-alike domain and demanded verification within 24 hours; do not act on it, and check your account only through the bank's own app or site.
reason: The memory flags the email as phishing from a look-alike domain, and nothing shows it was dealt with; the account number 4471 is not in the cited memories, so it was dropped.
